items.value: Yellow sleep condition AND PVT yellow (V016) at the same time
Orange condition within 24 h before a critical task (EVA, docking, landing)
items.source_doc: Sleep ER: Risk of Performance Decrements and Adverse Health Outcomes Resulting from Sleep Loss, Circadian Desynchronization, and Work Overload (HRP, 2016)
items.quote: Setting limits can be especially important during periods of critical operations.

items.value: Yellow: protect sleep period, nap, pre-sleep lighting setting, caffeine timing. Orange: schedule/workload change. Red: flight surgeon review of schedule or sleep medication
items.source_doc: Sleep ER: Risk of Performance Decrements and Adverse Health Outcomes Resulting from Sleep Loss, Circadian Desynchronization, and Work Overload (HRP, 2016)
items.quote: Currently flight surgeons work with other operational personnel to modify flight schedules to allow for adequate sleep and time off on a case-by-case basis
